rows: Maintenance Procedures Information System
Networks
Maintenance Procedures
Document No: DES-006-r0a
Equipment: Medium Voltage Distribution Boards
Issued To: Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company
Status: APPROVED
Approval Date: 27 February 2008
Procedure: Half-Yearly Maintenance (P1-M6)
Next Review Date: February 2013

sections_en.text: Introduction

This document outlines the P1 periodic maintenance procedures, which must be carried out every six months as indicated above by the code M6, on the medium voltage distribution boards installed at substations. This document was prepared, reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators in the zones of the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company, and this maintenance is carried out in accordance with the manufacturers' instructions and acquired experience, with the aim of avoiding sudden faults and raising the efficiency of the distribution boards' equipment.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order; the maintenance staff must hold the appropriate occupational safety and health category card
The work area must be fenced off and warning signs put in place
Safety and occupational health equipment and personal protective equipment must be worn: safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles, gloves, mask, etc., as appropriate for the work
Ensure that the tools, instruments, devices, spare parts and materials used in the maintenance are available
Ensure that the cells are numbered and labelled from the front and the back
Ensure that there is no voltage from the supply source and no back-feed voltage, using a valid, tested voltage indicator on the part to be worked on
Ensure that a portable earth is applied to the equipment to be worked on
Ensure that the DC supply of the part to be worked on is isolated
Ensure that a suitable portable fire extinguisher is available at the work site
Close the valves of the automatic fire-extinguishing system with the sensitive hose until work on the board is finished

items: Ensure that the cells are numbered and labelled from the front and the back
Ensure that a suitable portable fire extinguisher is available at the work site
Close the valves of the automatic fire-extinguishing system with the sensitive hose until work on the board is finished

sections_en.text: Tools and Equipment
A valid, tested voltage indicator
A complete tool kit
Blower or a suitable vacuum cleaner
Brushes and soft, clean cloth pieces for cleaning
Primer and cell paint material in the same colour
Lubricating oil and suitable electrical grease (graphite, silicone or medical Vaseline)
Numbering machine
Portable earth
First-aid kit
Spare lighting lamps
Opening and closing time measuring device; contact resistance measuring device (yearly)

items: A valid, tested voltage indicator
A complete tool kit
Blower or a suitable vacuum cleaner
Brushes and soft, clean cloth pieces for cleaning
Primer and cell paint material in the same colour
Lubricating oil and suitable electrical grease (graphite, silicone or medical Vaseline)
Petrol, rust-removing spray and oil-free spray (video cleaner)
Numbering machine
Portable earth
First-aid kit
Spare lighting lamps
Opening and closing time measuring device; contact resistance measuring device (yearly)

sections_en.text: Work to be Carried Out
First: Circuit Breakers

rows: Ensure that the circuit breaker is open
Disconnect the secondary circuits (socket) from the circuit breaker
Withdraw the circuit breaker from the cell
Discharge the circuit breaker mechanism spring
Clean the circuit breaker insulators from dust or any other contaminants with the blower and a clean cloth piece
Ensure that the insulators are free from scratches or cracks
Inspect the connection points (contacts) and replace any damaged ones found (the old grease is removed with petrol, then greased with a thin layer of carbon grease)
Inspect the connecting arms and ensure that they are firmly fixed to the circuit breaker body and in the correct position
Clean the socket with an oil-free cleaning liquid (video cleaner)
Remove the outer face of the circuit breaker using the appropriate tools
Inspect the circuit breaker mechanism carefully, clean it with rust-removing spray, and check the tightness of its parts
Check the oil level in oil circuit breakers and change it if necessary
Read and record the SF6 gas pressure value, if present (for gas circuit breakers)
Lubricate the wheels of the circuit breaker trolley to ease the movement of the circuit breaker
Test the manual opening and closing of the circuit breakers
Measure the opening time and the closing time of the circuit breaker (yearly) (opening time about 30 ms, not exceeding 50 ms) (closing time about 60 ms, not exceeding 100 ms)
Measure the contact resistance of the circuit breaker (yearly) (contact resistance about 30 micro-ohms, not exceeding 100 micro-ohms).
Refit the outer face of the circuit breaker and ensure that all bolts and nuts are tightened.
Put the circuit breaker in the test position (Test Position)
Connect the DC supply (socket) to the circuit breaker cell
Check the earthing circuit of the circuit breaker cell
Ensure that the busbars are insulated with Raychem
Test the mechanical and electrical opening and closing of the circuit breaker

Ensure that the indication lamps (opening and closing), the circuit breaker operating position (mechanical semaphore: connected, disconnected) and the spring charging position indicator are sound ("charged/discharged")
Check the numbering and labelling of the cells from the front and the back
Check that the doors are tightly closed and the cable openings are sealed
Disconnect the DC supply (socket) from the circuit breaker cell

sections_en.text: Second: Busbars

rows: Treat any sharp edges on the busbar ends, if present, and insulate the busbars with Raychem
Clean the busbar support insulators and check them for cracks or surface discharge (Flash Over)
Check the insulating spacers (floor boxes) supporting the busbars between the cells
Check the painting of the busbars in the distinctive phase colours
Ensure that surge arresters are installed on the distribution busbars and that they are sound
Check the connections and contact points on the distribution busbars
Check the connections and contact points on the voltage and current transformers
Check the sensitive hose of the automatic powder fire-extinguishing system

sections_en.text: Third: Cells
a- Circuit Breaker Cell

rows: Check the earthing of the cell
Clean the cell by vacuuming the dust from it and removing any other contaminants
Grease the circuit breaker wheel track and the mechanical interlock
Check the insulating spacers (shutters) and that they move easily
Check the insulating spacers between the cells
Check the performance of the cell earth switch (if fitted) and lubricate its drive shafts
Check the sensitive hose of the automatic powder fire-extinguishing system
Check the performance of the cell heaters (if fitted with heaters)
Check that the cells are tightly closed and the openings are sealed
Check the painting, numbering and labelling of the cells from the front and the back

sections_en.text: b- Voltage and Current Transformers Cell

rows: Check the earthing of the cell
Clean the instrument transformers cell by vacuuming the dust from it and removing any other contaminants
Check the primary connections of the instrument transformers to the busbars and cables
Check the insulating spacers between the cells
Check the sensitive hose of the automatic powder fire-extinguishing system
Check that the cells are tightly closed and the openings are sealed

sections_en.text: c- Surge Arresters Cell

rows: Check the earthing of the cell and the earthing of the surge arresters
Clean the surge arresters cell by vacuuming the dust from it and removing any other contaminants
Check that the cells are tightly closed and the openings are sealed

sections_en.text: Fourth: Cables

rows: Ensure that the cable trenches are clean and the cables inside them are sound, and ensure that the cable trenches have covers
Check the numbering of the cables
Check the soundness of the fastening and fixing of the clamp holding the cable "and supporting it so that the cable weight is not carried by the current transformers to which it is connected"
Check the earthing of the cable shields "from one side only for cables shorter than 500 metres"
Check that the cables are laid neatly in the trenches, the spacing between them, and that they are separated from each other so that fire does not spread from one to another
Check the cable end boxes, their earthing and painting with a fire-retardant material, and that there is no oil leakage from them for oil-filled boxes, if present
Ensure that the cable openings are sealed
Ensure that there is no seepage water in the cable trenches

sections_en.text: Fifth: Steps for Returning the Distribution Board to Service

rows: Remove the portable earths, store them in their place and verify their number
Insert the circuit breakers into their cells and ensure the good engagement between the moving contact in the circuit breaker and the fixed contact in the cell
Open the valves of the automatic fire-extinguishing system with the sensitive hose
Connect the DC supply to the cells
Contact the supplied parties to reconnect the feeders
Reconnect the feeder circuit breakers
Evacuate the area and close the work order
